item.title: Import and Merge Designs
item.description: Import turns an existing configuration into an editable design. Kanvas identifies the format from the file content, converts it to a Meshery design, and saves it as a new design in your account. A File Upload or URL Import does not keep the original file, so exporting later produces a new file from the current design. A GitHub import is different: the design stays bound to its source, as described in Where the imported design lands.
